SAT:sega-worldwide-soccer-97.d: Sega Worldwide Soccer 97 is a 1996 football video game developed by Sega's Team Aquila for the Sega Saturn. Released in Japan as Victory Goal Worldwide Edition, it was subsequently ported to Microsoft Windows in 1997, where the Japanese edition was titled Sega Worldwide Soccer PC. A successor to Victory Goal, the game features international national teams and several league and cup competition modes. The Saturn version received widespread critical acclaim, particularly for its player animations, controls and tactical options. Contemporary publications regarded it as one of the console's leading football games, with Saturn Power praising its depth and artificial intelligence.

A port for the Nintendo Switch was released in Japan in March 2017, as a launch title for the system, and worldwide in May 2017, under the title Disgaea 5 Complete, containing all DLC content from the original, but no new content. Mac:baldurs-gate-3-black-hound.d: Baldur's Gate III: The Black Hound is a cancelled role-playing video game developed by Black Isle Studios and intended to be published by Interplay Entertainment for Microsoft Windows. Announced in 2002 under the codenames FR6 and Project Jefferson, it was planned to be the third main entry in the Baldur's Gate series, utilizing the Dungeons & Dragons 3rd Edition ruleset. The game was set to use the developer's proprietary 3D graphics engine rather than the Infinity Engine used for the studio's previous games. The Black Hound was cancelled in 2003 when Interplay lost the rights to develop further Dungeons & Dragons games for the PC platform.
